description: Source code for buffalo-lib.c implementing CRC32, checksum, encryption, file I/O, and buffer utilities for firmware handling.

methods.name: bcrypt_init
methods.description: Initializes bcrypt context with key and state length.

methods.name: bcrypt_process
methods.description: Processes data with bcrypt context for encryption/decryption.

methods.name: bcrypt_buf
methods.description: Encrypts or decrypts buffer using bcrypt.

methods.name: buffalo_crc
methods.description: Calculates CRC checksum over buffer using precomputed table.

methods.name: enc_compute_header_len
methods.description: Computes header length for encoding based on product and version strings.

methods.name: enc_compute_buf_len
methods.description: Computes total buffer length for encoding data.

methods.name: put_be32
methods.description: Stores a 32-bit integer in big-endian format.

methods.name: get_be32
methods.description: Reads a 32-bit big-endian integer from data.

methods.name: check_magic
methods.description: Checks if magic string matches expected start or asar1.

methods.name: encrypt_buf
methods.description: Encrypts buffer with header info using specified parameters.

methods.name: decrypt_buf
methods.description: Decrypts buffer with header info and verifies checksum.
